title: Unused os import breaks Ruff lint gate
reasoning: The route module imports os but never uses it. The project Ruff configuration selects Pyflakes rules, so this triggers F401 and causes the lint command to fail before release/CI can pass.
reproduction: From ghostwriter/: `ruff check --no-cache app/api/logs.py` reports `F401 [*] os imported but unused` at app/api/logs.py:3.
recommendation: Remove the unused `os` import from app/api/logs.py.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and runtime tests generally do not catch unused imports unless the lint gate is run.
minimumFixScope: Delete the single unused import line.
